author: chrishanw
body:
#### PR description:

This makes the improved and sped-up E/Gamma pixel seeding chain, introduced in #49436 (with follow-up bug fixes) the default.

#### PR validation:

Extensive validation including several bug fixes has been made in the past, the bugfix PRs are #49730 (implementing some comments), #50401 and #51451 , the performance has been presented in various E/Gamma, HLT, TSG meetings.
title: Make the simplified and sped-up E/Gamma pixel seeding the default.
